slug: 2025-04-03 Now is the time to invest in locally-owned health data systems

systems.system: DHIS2 (routine immunization and vaccine supply-chain data)

note: Its one statement on Nigeria is that combining routine immunization and vaccine supply-chain data in DHIS2 has helped reduce stock-outs and raise coverage: one programme's reporting, so noted as a system and no fact. Its general statements on national DHIS2 systems staying online after the 2025 US funding cuts are not made of Nigeria.
